identity_recovery_tokens_operator_refere.name: identity_recovery_tokens_operator_reference_check
identity_recovery_tokens_operator_refere.value: "identity_recovery_tokens"."operator_reference" IS NULL OR (octet_length("identity_recovery_tokens"."operator_reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "identity_recovery_tokens"."operator_reference" COLLATE "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$')

attachments_filename_check.name: attachments_filename_check
attachments_filename_check.value:
char_length("attachments"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
        AND "attachments"."filename" !~ '[\x01-\x1f\x7f-\x9f/\\]'
        AND btrim("attachments"."filename") <> ''
        AND "attachments"."filename" NOT IN ('.', '..')

attachments_lifecycle_check.name: attachments_lifecycle_check
attachments_lifecycle_check.value:
("attachments"."status" = 'ready') = ("attachments"."verified_size" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."verified_checksum" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("attachments"."status" = 'failed') = ("attachments"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)

attachments_deletion_check.name: attachments_deletion_check
attachments_deletion_check.value:
("attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR "attachments"."status" = 'ready')
        AND ("attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL) = ("attachments"."purge_after" IS NULL)

attachments_visibility_targets_check.name: attachments_visibility_targets_check
attachments_visibility_targets_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("attachments"."visibility_targets") = 'array' AND (
        ("attachments"."visibility_mode" IN ('gm_only', 'everyone') AND "attachments"."visibility_targets" = '[]'::jsonb)
        OR ("attachments"."visibility_mode" IN ('party', 'players') AND jsonb_array_length("attachments"."visibility_targets") > 0)
      )

export_jobs_lifecycle_check.name: export_jobs_lifecycle_check
export_jobs_lifecycle_check.value:
("export_jobs"."state" IN ('completed', 'failed')) = ("export_jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("export_jobs"."state" = 'completed') = ("export_jobs"."manifest_checksum" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("export_jobs"."state" = 'failed') = ("export_jobs"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

import_jobs_lifecycle_check.name: import_jobs_lifecycle_check
import_jobs_lifecycle_check.value:
("import_jobs"."state" IN ('completed', 'failed')) = ("import_jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("import_jobs"."state" = 'completed') = ("import_jobs"."campaign_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("import_jobs"."state" = 'failed') = ("import_jobs"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

content_entities_name_check.name: content_entities_name_check
content_entities_name_check.value:
char_length("content_entities"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "content_entities"."name" = btrim("content_entities"."name")
        AND "content_entities"."name" ~ '[^[:space:]]'

content_entities_tags_check.name: content_entities_tags_check
content_entities_tags_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("content_entities"."tags") = 'array'
        THEN jsonb_array_length("content_entities"."tags") <= 32 ELSE false END

content_entities_visibility_targets_chec.name: content_entities_visibility_targets_check
content_entities_visibility_targets_chec.value:
CASE WHEN NOT content_visibility_targets_valid("content_entities"."visibility_targets") THEN false
        WHEN "content_entities"."visibility_mode" IN ('gm_only', 'everyone')
          THEN "content_entities"."visibility_targets" = '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE jsonb_array_length("content_entities"."visibility_targets") > 0 END

content_personal_notes_tags_check.name: content_personal_notes_tags_check
content_personal_notes_tags_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("content_personal_notes"."tags") = 'array'
        THEN jsonb_array_length("content_personal_notes"."tags") <= 32 ELSE false END
